title: Review scene-off lighting isolation repair
objective: Review Builder's fix for residual light in scene-off flashlight orbit renders, focusing on correctness of show-flag selection, console command fallback, capture component configuration, tests, and risk of breaking natural co-located flashlight appearance.
instructions: Review the changed files only: examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py and tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py.

Pay special attention to whether disabling Materials while enabling LightingOnlyOverride is likely to make scene_off_flashlight_on unusably artificial or whether it is acceptable for a flashlight-only diagnostic render.
Check that try_execute_console_command uses correct Unreal reflected argument names and cannot accidentally report success on a failed command.
Check that the show-flag property assignment fallback is plausible for SPEAR's JSON/property bridge and does not mask a runtime failure.
Do not modify files. Return findings with file/line references and a clear go/no-go for visual validation.
definition_of_done: Major correctness risks are identified before another Unreal validation run.
